messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy to devtest environment
env=devtest, tag=release/v3.4.1-rc2, commit=abc1234, pool=dev-gpu-pool-1, rollout=10% (canary). Triggered by pipeline #4821. ETA ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alice M: Copy. Any DB migrations included?
deploy-bot: There is one migration queued: 20260320-add-kv-cache-index.sql. It is currently set to dry-run only for this deploy. Running dry-run now.
qa-bot: Smoke suite triggered (id=9876). Tests: infra, api, model-integration. ETA ~3m.
Ben P: If dry-run is green, can we apply migration to canary only? prefer not to touch shared devtest DB.
Carol S: +1 to canary-only for migration. If any schema mismatch, abort canary and rollback to previous tag.
Dmitri: I'll monitor latency, kv-cache hitrate, and error logs. Setting alerts: latency>200ms, error_rate>1%.
deploy-bot: Dry-run output:
```
$ ./migrate --env=devtest --dry-run 20260320-add-kv-cache-index.sql
DRY RUN OK: would add index on kv_store(namespace, key)
---
No blocking warnings.
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to 10% started. Instances: devtest-canary-3, devtest-canary-4. Healthcheck timeout=300s. :rocket:
qa-bot: Smoke results: 3/3 services started. One flaky failure in reranker integration (see below).
Alice M: Which test failed? send the failing assertion/logs.
qa-bot: Failing test: /tests/model/reranker_integration.py::test_top_k_consistency
Output snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected top-3 ids [a,b,c], got [a,c,b]
Request latency (canary): 245ms, baseline: 120ms
```
Ben P: That looks like a timing/cold-cache issue, not a model drift. Recommend hold at 10% and re-run reranker test with warmed cache.
deploy-bot: Holding canary at 10%. Auto-escalation window set to 30m. :pause_button:
Carol S: Note: build was compiled with `cuda:cu118-opt` but infra default is `cu117`. FP behaviour differences possible. Can we pin runtime for canary?
Dmitri: Confirmed build-runtime=cu118. I'll pin canary runtime to `cuda:cu118-opt` to match.
deploy-bot: Applied runtime pin to canary: profile=`cuda:cu118-opt`.
qa-bot: Re-run smoke (id=9877) scheduled.
deploy-bot: Warm-up script available at https://git.internal/redwood/warmup#kv. Running warm-up to prepopulate KV cache on canary instances.
Ben P: I ran the reranker integration locally against canary with warm-up script; top-k consistent after warm-up. Warm-up steps: `./warmup --service reranker --requests 500 --seed 42`.
Carol S: Good. Add warm-up hook to canary rollout and then increase to 30% after 15m.
Alice M: Please annotate the deployment with tag:kv-warmup and link the warmup run id.
deploy-bot: Warm-up hook added. Increasing canary to 30% now. New instances: devtest-canary-5..8. Rolling incrementally. :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: Smoke id=9878 run complete: all tests pass, reranker stable.
dmitri: Monitoring update: latency returned to baseline across endpoints, kv-cache hitrate at 92%. No increase in errors.
Ben P: No further flakiness observed after warm-up. Looks safe to progress.
Carol S: Proceed with gradual rollout; keep migration as canary-only for now. We'll evaluate applying migration cluster-wide after 24h of stable metrics.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for devtest: tag=release/v3.4.1-rc2, status=completed, duration=38m. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/release/v3.4.1-rc2. Release notes snippet: - kv cache index (dry-run applied to canary) - runtime pin cu118 for canary - warm-up hook for reranker.
Dmitri: Dashboards look steady, no alerts triggered. Closing monitoring window.
Alice M: Thanks all. I'll open a follow-up ticket to schedule migration apply to staging after 24h of good metrics.
Ben P: Nice rollout. :thumbsup:
